title: Vault curator can force `operator.claimReward()` to revert with precision
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High    **Likelihood:** Low  ## Description  A vault curator can allocate a **very small amount** of stake to an operator. Due to precision loss (e.g., rounding errors) in `_getRewardsAmountPerVault()`, the vault may end up with a **reward amount of zero**. ```solidity     function _getRewardsAmountPerVault(         address[] memory operatorVaults,         uint256 totalVaults,         uint48 epochStartTs,         address operator,         address middlewareAddress,         uint256 stakerAmount     ) private view returns (uint256[] memory amountPerVault) {         --Sni
